description: Redirection forms beyond `exec`: order, duplication, noclobber, here-documents, fd variables.

cases.name: redirect: order of dup and file
cases.script: cd /tmp; { echo out; echo err >&2; } >f 2>&1; cat f; { echo out; echo err >&2; } 2>&1 >g | sed s/^/pipe:/; cat g

cases.name: redirect: append and truncate
cases.script: cd /tmp; echo one >f; echo two >>f; cat f; : >f; wc -c <f; >f2 echo pre; cat f2

cases.name: redirect: both streams
cases.script: cd /tmp; { echo o; echo e >&2; } &>f; cat f; { echo o2; echo e2 >&2; } &>>f; cat f

cases.name: redirect: noclobber
cases.script: cd /tmp; echo a >f; set -C; echo b >f; echo status=$?; echo c >|f; cat f; echo d >>f; cat f; set +C

cases.name: redirect: read and write descriptor
cases.script: cd /tmp; echo hello >f; exec 3<>f; read -u 3 w; echo $w; exec 3>&-

cases.name: redirect: duplicate input
cases.script: cd /tmp; echo line >f; exec 4<f; cat <&4; exec 4<&-

cases.name: redirect: move descriptors
cases.script: cd /tmp; exec 5>f; exec 6>&5-; echo moved >&6; exec 6>&-; cat f; echo x >&5; echo status=$?

cases.name: redirect: close stdout
cases.script: { echo gone; } >&-; echo status=$?; echo visible

cases.name: redirect: descriptor variables
cases.script: cd /tmp; exec {fd}>f; echo "via $fd" >&$fd; [ $fd -ge 10 ] && echo high; exec {fd}>&-; cat f

cases.name: redirect: descriptor variable read
cases.script: cd /tmp; printf "a\nb\n" >f; exec {in}<f; read -u $in x; read -u $in y; echo $x$y; exec {in}<&-

cases.name: redirect: here document expansion
cases.script:
x=val; cat <<EOF
$x $(echo sub) $((1+1)) \$literal
EOF

cases.name: redirect: quoted here document
cases.script:
x=val; cat <<'EOF'
$x $(echo no)
EOF
cat <<"E2"
$x
E2

cases.name: redirect: here document tab stripping
cases.script:
cat <<-EOF
	indented
		deeper
	EOF

cases.name: redirect: here documents on one command
cases.script:
cat <<A - <<B
first
A
second
B

cases.name: redirect: here document unterminated
cases.script:
cat <<EOF
no end

cases.name: redirect: here string forms
cases.script: x="a b"; cat <<< $x; cat <<< "$x"; wc -l <<< ""; read -r v <<< "  spaced  "; echo "[$v]"

cases.name: redirect: missing input file
cases.script: cat </tmp/nosuch; echo status=$?; echo after

cases.name: redirect: missing output directory
cases.script: echo x >/tmp/nodir/f; echo status=$?

cases.name: redirect: ambiguous redirect
cases.script: e=; echo x >$e; echo status=$?; s="a b"; echo x >$s; echo status=$?

cases.name: redirect: redirect a directory
cases.script: echo x >/tmp; echo status=$?; cat </tmp; echo status=$?

cases.name: redirect: stdin stdout stderr paths
cases.script: echo out >/dev/stdout; echo err >/dev/stderr 2>&1; echo in | cat /dev/stdin; echo fd | cat /dev/fd/0

cases.name: redirect: redirections on compound commands
cases.script: cd /tmp; for i in 1 2; do echo $i; done >loop; if true; then echo if; fi >>loop; { echo grp; } >>loop; cat loop

cases.name: redirect: input to a loop
cases.script: cd /tmp; printf "1\n2\n" >nums; while read n; do echo n$n; done <nums; s=0; while read n; do s=$((s+n)); done <nums; echo $s

cases.name: redirect: per-command redirect does not persist
cases.script: cd /tmp; echo a >f 2>/dev/null; echo shown; ls nosuch 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: redirect: numbered descriptor to file
cases.script: cd /tmp; { echo three >&3; } 3>f; cat f; echo x 1>&2 2>/dev/null

cases.name: redirect: bad descriptor
cases.script: echo x >&7; echo status=$?; cat <&8; echo status=$?
